name: npc_samurai-guard-01
customDialogue: No one passes the watch posts without the Captain's leave.

name: npc_samurai-villager-01
customDialogue:
The watch posts went up overnight.
My children ask if the tunnels are coming for us.

name: npc_samurai-captain-01
customDialogue:
Order first. Then answers.
The Samurai have kept this colony standing for a long time.

name: npc_samurai-instructor-01
customDialogue:
Draw last. Sheathe first.
The yard teaches the rest.

spotConfig.label: Read the decree
spotConfig.text: BY ORDER OF THE SAMURAI: The old tunnels are closed to every ant. Watch posts will stand on every road near a tunnel sign. No one goes below without the Captain's leave.

spotConfig.label: Inspect the watch post
spotConfig.text: A barrier of sharpened poles across the path to the east burrow, a lantern that never goes out, and fresh Samurai seals on every knot.

spotConfig.label: Inspect the watch post
spotConfig.text: The second post closes the burrow by the road outside the gate. The rope is new, the seals are new, and the guard will not meet your eyes.

spotConfig.label: Look for a way around
spotConfig.text: This burrow is roped off too. Every tunnel mouth the Samurai know is watched. If there is another road, it is one the Samurai never knew. The Ronin know roads no map remembers.
South-west tower: the path along the palisade is clear, but the tower lantern is dark.
South-east tower: market carts are parked across the lane. A patrol would have to squeeze past them.
North-west tower: quiet. Behind the forge the palisade hums faintly when the ground shakes.
North-east tower: the bamboo has grown right across the patrol path.
The stream from the far waterfall ends here, in a still pond ringed by stones. Under the water a carved stone lantern lies on its side, as if it fell a very long time ago.

spotConfig.label: Read the old stone
spotConfig.text: At the foot of the dojo terrace, outside the wall where no one walks, a stone carries the names of the first Samurai. The last name has been chiselled out.

spotConfig.label: Look into the forge

requires.hint: The forge is cold by day. The smiths say it wakes at night.

spotConfig.text: Deep in the dark forge one ember still glows. In its light you see a blade on the anvil with a red line running down its edge.
The storm tears the petals from the great cherry. For a moment they swirl around you in the shape of a sword.

spotConfig.label: Look into the burrow
spotConfig.text: This burrow goes down three steps and stops at a wall of packed earth. Someone has scratched a tally on it: forty marks, then nothing.

spotConfig.label: Look closer
spotConfig.text: A tiny ant peeks out at you.

hotspots.description:
Disciplined core soldiers of the colony. The ant silhouette on red stands for loyalty, structure and ancestral pride.

A Samurai holds the line when others break it, trains until the blade moves before the thought, and never forgets the names of those who stood here before.

Bow at the door.
Leave your sandals at the shelf.
Speak softly near the kamiza.
Train as if the colony is watching. It is.
Clean the floor you trained on.
